chapter_seo_title: Chapter 559: Han Li vs Grade 9 Demons – A Desperate, Futile Stand
chapter_meta_description: Han Li faces three Transformation-stage demon beasts. His most powerful attacks fail, his trump cards are crushed, and he must gamble on a desperate new strategy.
og_title: Han Li’s Power Leap Meets a Terrifying Ceiling
og_description: Core Formation meets Transformation in a brutal demonstration of the cultivation world’s unforgiving hierarchy.
twitter_title: When Your Best Shots Are Gnats: Han Li’s Despair
twitter_description: This chapter proves that no matter how clever Han Li is, raw power levels are still a thing.

lore_anchors.definition: A high-grade demon beast, known as *Lie Feng Shou*, which cultivates by absorbing the power of the wind and is considered a type of bird/beast hybrid.
A top-tier demon beast in the human realm, capable of Transformation. It represents a catastrophic power gap for any Core Formation cultivator.
A high-grade protective magical armor made from the scales of an Emperor-tier demon beast; an astonishingly valuable treasure.
A defensive technique derived from the Azure Origin Sword Art that projects a rotating shield of azure sword lights and golden lightning arcs.
The third major cultivation stage, where a practitioner condenses their power into a 'Golden Core' within their dantian. Locked term.
The stage at which a demon beast can condense its power into a humanoid form, granting huge increases in magical power and intelligence. Locked term.
A variant of the *Gold Devourer Beetles*' energy signature, described as golden lightning that counters evil and demonic arts.
A legendary flight treasure made from the three thousand feathers of a pair of grade 8 demon beasts from the Wind and Lightning races. Not yet fully refined.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why couldn't Han Li's flying swords hurt the Grade 8 demons?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because of the rigid cultivation world hierarchy: a Core Formation cultivator's raw power is inherently incapable of damaging a Transformation-stage demon's physical body without a specific high-level counter.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the Wind Split Beast panic?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He panicked because Han Li started attacking the furnace's protective barrier, threatening to destroy the nearly-complete Wind Lightning Wings, a treasure the demon valued above his own allies.
